subject: PROC_PIDPATHINFO_MAXSIZE in Swift on macOS 26 SDK
detail: The PROC_PIDPATHINFO_MAXSIZE macro in <libproc.h> uses an unsupported C structure and is not importable from Swift. Inline the literal 4096 (= 4 * MAXPATHLEN) with a comment explaining why.

subject: Xcode PBXFileSystemSynchronizedRootGroup
detail: DevWatchdog.xcodeproj uses PBXFileSystemSynchronizedRootGroup, so new .swift files dropped into DevWatchdog/ or DevWatchdogTests/ are auto-picked up by the build. No pbxproj mutation required for new source files.

subject: xctest runner reparents to launchd under xcodebuild
detail: When running via xcodebuild, the xctest runner's parent process is PID 1 (launchd), not xcodebuild. Any test asserting 'ppid != 1 for self' must use XCTSkip in this environment.

subject: PROC_PIDVNODEPATHINFO + proc_vnodepathinfo in Swift on macOS 26 SDK
detail: Unlike PROC_PIDPATHINFO_MAXSIZE (unimportable), the proc_vnodepathinfo struct + its nested types (vnode_info_path, vinfo_stat) are fully Swift-importable on macOS 26. Use MemoryLayout<proc_vnodepathinfo>.stride + withUnsafeBytes pattern analogous to pbi_comm extraction. No raw-buffer workaround needed.

subject: Behavior-contract test for feature-flag-gated migrations
detail: For feature-flag-gated code paths, add one explicit test asserting that when all new flags are OFF, the new optional fields are nil AND the result set equals the pre-feature baseline. This catches silent regressions in the legacy path that unit tests on new code paths will miss. Implemented in LibProcSignalClassifierTests.test_defaultFlags_behaviorUnchanged_preservesBaseline.
